prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone, but **Dr. David McFadden at The Dental Implant Center** is a strong Dallas option to consider, particularly for complex cases or full-mouth reconstruction. The available listings describe him as a board-certified prosthodontist with implant-focused credentials. His office is at **5120 W. Lovers Lane**; **(214) 956-9100**.

For a second opinion, **Dr. Kathia Steel**, a board-certified prosthodontist at **8117 Preston Road**, is another option. A prosthodontist specializes in replacing and restoring teeth; implant surgery may also involve a periodontist or oral surgeon.

Before choosing, ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what the full treatment plan and total cost include, and what alternatives and risks apply to your case. Verify credentials and insurance coverage directly with the office, and consider getting two consultations—especially if bone grafting or multiple implants are involved.
